bibliographic.title: A Little Guidance for A Big Heart
bibliographic.author: Norbez Jones (call me Bez)
bibliographic.description:
Eugene goes to the club with his tiny friend Gabe as a wingman in their pocket, feeding them advice via Airpod.  Will Eugene be able to find love tonight?  Do they even need to?

__________

This is a game I made for Shufflecomp 2024, the 2nd of 3 games I made for that event (you can play the 1st one here).  It started as a short little writing exercise, and grew from there.  I didn't intend this to be an aroace project at first, but it ended up going in that direction, and I'm glad it did.  Everyone on the team did a really great job; I've been wanting to work on a game with most of these folks for a long time now too!  Enjoy, and please leave a comment with your thoughts!

-- Bez

P.S. Here's a playlist of the Shufflecomp songs that fueled this game!
